title: AquarIum
excerpt: Each AI model is told to build a tank and one creature inside it.
content_html:
An art show where every piece was made by AI.

12 different AI models were given the same instructions to build a tank and one creature inside it.

Everything you see was made by the AI writing code. Select your favorite tank to find out which AI made each one!

The Models tab lists every AI model in this gallery.
The Prompt tab shows the exact instructions they got.
